            block = data[pos:pos+2880].decode("ascii", errors="ignore")
            pos += 2880
            for i in range(0, 2880, 80):

                if card.startswith("END     "):

                if "=" in card[:10]:

                    v = card[10:].split("/")[0].strip().strip("\x27 ")
                    hdr[k] = v
            if "END     " in [block[i:i+8] for i in range(0, 2880, 80)]:

        naxis = int(hdr.get("NAXIS", 0))
